name: Riffle
tagline: Read and listen to books from your own home server
description:
Riffle lets you read and listen to your books on Android, pulling from several self-hosted sources like Audiobookshelf, Komga, and Project Gutenberg. It's built for people who keep their ebook and audiobook collections on their own server instead of a paid cloud service.

It supports EPUB, PDF, and CBZ files, plus audiobooks, along with annotations so you can mark up what you're reading.
